_comment: The deploy model's form layout. PDC Bootstrap Deploy Model overwrites the model's existing form stencil with this (old JSON saved to previous_configuration first). No other installer method edits the stencil; they only write field values that this layout renders. Each element is a group (with elements), a field (an attribute on the deploy model), or a text element whose text is read from text_path in the repo.

elements.label: Role that can use PDC Integration Map buttons
